articles.title: Three horizons of quantum: A business road map to the future computing economy
articles.summary: In the next decade, quantum technology could create trillions in value and break encryption, delivering opportunity but also risk. Leading companies are acting now to secure a competitive advantage.

articles.title: Switch tracks: Rewiring rolling stock for a new era
articles.summary: Fast-growing markets in Asia are difficult for global rail OEMs to access. Value could shift from new builds toward servicing and renewals—while OEMs prepare for future opportunities.

articles.title: Securing software in the age of AI: Red Hat CTO Chris Wright
articles.summary: Open-source veteran Chris Wright explains why AI-driven vulnerability discovery is forcing a reckoning for software security, and how the industry can emerge stronger as a result.

articles.title: Closing the women’s health gap: Switzerland’s CHF 7 billion opportunity
articles.summary: Addressing the women’s health gap in Switzerland could deliver eight additional healthy days per year for every woman and potentially contribute more than 7 billion Swiss francs in annual GDP by 2040.

articles.title: The next era of US retirement: Four shifts redefining competition
articles.summary: The US retirement industry is entering a new era. Four shifts, from AI to product innovation, are redefining where value will be created.
